notes: Desktop/wall-mount digital signage player (fanless, sealed, VESA-mountable) - no rack units. Only one video output can be active at a time (HDMI 2.0 OR DisplayPort 1.2 via USB-C, not concurrently, per official wiki). The 3 physical USB-C ports are all electrically USB 3.0/lockable, but functionally assigned per manufacturer diagrams: (1) power input, marked with DC symbol, located next to the HDMI port - USB-C PD 2.0, 27W min 3A@9V; (2) DisplayPort 1.2 Alt-Mode video output, marked DP++; (3) general-purpose USB 3.0 host (external storage, or SpinetiX's optional USB-C-to-analog-audio breakout cable accessory). Modeled the general-purpose port as bidirectional usb-c with grade usb-5g (USB 3.0 = 5Gbps). No physical RS232, IR, or analog 3.5mm/RCA audio jack exists on the chassis itself - analog stereo audio requires an external USB-C dongle/cable accessory sold separately, so no dedicated onboard analog-audio port is listed. HMP400W variant adds Wi-Fi (802.11ac Wave 2) with no additional physical port. Ethernet is 1GbE with PoE+ (802.3at) as the primary/preferred power path; USB-C PD is the secondary power path - both are legitimate power inputs per SpinetiX, so RJ45 is marked bidirectional (also carries PoE) and the dedicated USB-C DC-in port is the explicit power connector. Sources cross-consistent: manufacturer product/spec page, SpinetiX Support Wiki (HMP400 and Get_started_with_the_HMP400 pages), and official "How To Set Up Your HMP400" PDF guide with port-location photos.

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Type-A, lockable; supports UHD 4K60; not usable concurrently with the DisplayPort output

ports.name: USB-C (Power)
ports.note: Marked with DC symbol; USB-C Power Delivery 2.0 input, 27W (min 3A@9V); positioned next to the HDMI port

ports.name: USB-C (DisplayPort)
ports.note: DisplayPort 1.2 Alternate Mode over USB-C, marked DP++; not usable concurrently with the HDMI output

ports.name: USB-C (USB 3.0)
ports.note: Lockable USB 3.0 host port; used for external storage or SpinetiX's optional USB-C-to-analog-audio breakout accessory

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 1GbE RJ45; also functions as power input via PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at)
